title: Kopi IoT
shortDescription: An IoT-based coffee grounds management system that helps coffee vendors monitor and manage their grounds levels efficiently.
description: Kopi IoT is an innovative platform that leverages Internet of Things technology to efficiently manage coffee grounds. Our system helps coffee vendors monitor their grounds levels and notifies drivers when it is time for collection, ensuring a cleaner environment and promoting sustainable practices.
features: IoT-based monitoring of coffee grounds levels
Real-time notifications for drivers when grounds are ready for collection
Admin dashboard for managing coffee vendors and drivers
Responsive design for mobile and desktop devices

title: Sidowaras
shortDescription: A website that provides information and guidance on Body Mass Index (BMI) and Basal Metabolic Rate (BMR) for the residents of Sidoarjo.
description: "SidoWaras" is the name of the website we have launched, derived from the phrase "Sidoarjo Waras" (meaning "Healthy Sidoarjo"). The site addresses the issue of body weight and health, providing information and guidance to the general public—particularly the residents of Sidoarjo—to help them understand their Body Mass Index (BMI) and daily caloric needs (BMR).
features: Interactive BMI and BMR calculators
Recommendation for healthy lifestyle choices based on BMI and BMR results
Educational content about healthy lifestyle choices
Responsive design for mobile and desktop devices

title: Samling AI
shortDescription: A data-driven waste management solution that optimizes waste collection operations using advanced analytics and machine learning.
description: Samling AI, derived from the Indonesian phrase “Sampah Lingkungan” is a data-driven waste management solution designed to improve the efficiency of waste collection operations. The platform leverages advanced data analytics and machine learning algorithms to optimize waste collection routes, predict waste generation patterns, and enhance overall operational efficiency.
features: User registration and authentication system
Predictive admin dashboard
Route recommendation for drivers based on waste generation patterns
Chatbot for society to report waste collection issues and provide feedback
Responsive design for mobile and desktop devices

title: Samling AI Driver
shortDescription: A mobile-first web app (PWA) designed for waste collection fleet drivers, providing smart navigation route guidance generated in real-time by an AI backend.
description: Samling Driver is a mobile-first web app (PWA) designed specifically for waste collection fleet drivers within the Samling AI ecosystem. The application provides smart navigation route guidance—generated in real-time by an AI backend—to effectively address waste accumulation at collection points.
features: Driver login and authentication system
Real-time route guidance based on AI-generated recommendations
Responsive design for mobile and desktop devices
